title: Blueprint op index and zone fast path (dungeon prerequisite, no output change)
player_outcome: No visible change. A far larger dungeon can generate, and it can answer 'am I in the dungeon?' for spawns, music and mining locks without scanning thousands of operations on the main thread.
design: Blueprint.Freeze(): build Dictionary<Int3, int[]> of op indices per chunk. Each op's bounds are expanded by 1 cell to cover the padded 34³ context. Op order is preserved; the dictionary is immutable afterwards (thread-safe reads).
Blueprint.OpsFor(Int3 chunk) returns the ops in original order (an empty array when none).
FeatureCarver.Stamp iterates blueprint.OpsFor(ctx.Coord) instead of every op.
Add bool NoZone to CarveOp and FillOp (Blueprint.Carve(box, liquid, noZone)) so approach cuts outside a building do not count as the zone. InZone ignores NoZone ops. The keep in P4-16 needs this.
tests: WorldGenTests golden hashes are unchanged, which proves no output change.
verification: dotnet test (golden hashes still pass); check_file_length
risks: An off-by-one in the padding expansion would silently skip ops at chunk borders. The golden hashes and the purity test catch it.
